name: Mitsumori Ichiya
source:
"Shall we first start with a kiss?"
Keyword: Love

The hero type who specializes in love who wants to always be an ideal lover.
He acts like a stylish composed adult and uses this to his advantage; however it undeniably feels somewhat fake.
